title: Supervisory Information (Banks) Regulations
source: Justice Laws Website (Department of Justice Canada)

sections.heading: Prescribed Supervisory Information
Prohibited Disclosure
sections.text: Subject to sections 3 and 4, a bank shall not, directly or indirectly, disclose information referred to in section 1.

sections.heading: Limited Disclosure
sections.text: A bank may disclose information referred to in section 1 to its affiliates or to its directors, officers, employees, auditors, securities underwriters or legal advisors, or to those of its affiliates, if the bank ensures that the information remains confidential.

sections.heading: Limited Disclosure
sections.text: A bank or any of its affiliates may disclose information referred to in paragraph 1(1)(c) if the bank or affiliate considers the information to contain a material fact or material change that is required by the securities laws of the relevant jurisdiction to be disclosed.

sections.heading: Coming into Force
sections.text: These Regulations come into force on the day on which they are registered.
